---
title: "DMR Landings"
output: github_document
---

A lightweight R package to simplify the import of [DMR annual commercial landings data](https://mainedmr.shinyapps.io/Landings_Portal/).  As described at the portal, the data are served in three forms:

+ "Historic" annual statewide totals per species (1880-2019)

+ "Modern" annual per-port totals per species (2008-2024)

We provide two more forms:

+ "Merged" a simple merging of the two where "historic" ports are assigned the value of "ME".  This form likely has limited value.

+ "Annualized" a simple state wide total per species per year.  This may be more useful than "merged".

+ "Consolidated" an extracted data set from decades of annual reports rich with tables of interest.  Reyn Yoshioka extracted the tabular data using Claude (details below). These are annual records by species.

The package should be updated every spring when [DMR updates the data source](https://mainedmr.shinyapps.io/Landings_Portal/), and after the [DMR annual commercial landings reports](https://www.maine.gov/dmr/fisheries/commercial) are published.

# Requirements

- [R v4.3+](https://www.r-project.org/)

- [readr](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=readr)

- [dplyr](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=dplyr)


# Installation

```
remotes::install("BigelowLab/dmrlandings")
```

# Usage

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dmrlandings)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

**Modern landings** data is broken down by species and port.
```{r}
x = read_dmr_landings("modern") |>
  glimpse()
```

**Historical landings** data are broken down by species only (statewide totals)

```{r}
x = read_dmr_landings("historic") |>
  glimpse()
```

**Annualized landings** data merges modern and historical data into species and port.

```{r}
x = read_dmr_landings("annualized") |>
  glimpse()
```

**Consolidated landings** data were in October 2026 extracted using Claude.  After extraction a random sample of 150 records were manually checked against the original report (all correct).  Subsequent years will be extracted by hand.  Important considerations when using these data...

 + whole pounds and live pounds were consolidated into pounds,
 + confidential and fishery closed indications were translated to flag columns (1 means confidential or closed),
 + salmon from 1990 and on are farmed,
 + from 2001-2007, sea cucumber landings are as reported by harvesters, from 2008 and on landings are from dealers,
 + all data are considered provisional by DMR, but future curators should understand that the last year on record is subject to change in the next year's report.
 
```{r}
x = read_dmr_landings("consolidated") |>
  glimpse()
```
